events.title: Arch Resources, Inc., et al. v. Pennington, Acting Dir., OWCP
events.summary: The Supreme Court granted the motion of respondent Cynthia E. Howard for attorneys' fees and expenses in the case of Arch Resources, Inc., et al. v. Pennington, Acting Dir., OWCP. The Court approved attorneys' fees of $24,915.00 and expenses of $2,282.05.
events.why_relevant: This order involves the awarding of legal fees, which is a procedural aspect of court cases.

events.title: Barreto, Michael v. United States
events.summary: The Supreme Court granted the motion for leave to file a petition for a writ of certiorari under seal with redacted copies for the public record in the case of Barreto, Michael v. United States. This allows the petitioner to submit sensitive information under seal while providing a redacted version for public access.
events.why_relevant: This order addresses the balance between confidentiality and public access in judicial proceedings.

events.title: CC/Devas Ltd., et al. v. Antrix Corp. Ltd., et al.
events.summary: The Supreme Court denied the motion of respondent Antrix Corporation Ltd. to modify the opinion issued on June 5, 2025, in the case of CC/Devas Ltd., et al. v. Antrix Corp. Ltd., et al. This decision leaves the original opinion unchanged.
events.why_relevant: This order maintains the status quo of a previous court opinion, affecting the parties involved.

events.title: Supreme Court denies partial stay in Google LLC v. Epic Games, Inc.
events.summary: The Supreme Court of the United States issued an order denying the application for a partial stay in the case of Google LLC, et al. v. Epic Games, Inc. The application was initially presented to Justice Kagan, who referred it to the full Court. The denial means that the lower court's decision will remain in effect while the case proceeds.
events.why_relevant: The denial of a partial stay affects the immediate legal standing and enforcement of the lower court's ruling in this high-profile case.

events.title: Supreme Court denies stay in Hamm v. Sockwell
events.summary: The Supreme Court denied the application for a stay in the case of Hamm, Commissioner, Alabama Department of Corrections v. Sockwell, Michael. The application was initially presented to Justice Thomas, who referred it to the full Court. The denial is without prejudice, allowing for a reapplication if a new trial becomes imminent. The order previously entered by Justice Thomas has been vacated.
events.why_relevant: The denial of a stay affects the immediate legal proceedings and potential outcomes in the case, impacting the administration of justice.

events.title: Certiorari Granted in Hunter v. United States
events.summary: The Supreme Court of the United States granted the petition for a writ of certiorari in the case of Hunter, Munson P. v. United States, docket number 24-1063. This means the Court has agreed to hear the case, which involves reviewing the decisions made by lower courts. The granting of certiorari indicates that the Court found the legal questions presented to be significant enough to warrant its review.
events.why_relevant: The order is relevant because it records the Court's decision not to review the lower-court judgment.
